caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with nori, chashu, menma, and naruto fish cake, artfully arranged in a white bowl. Warm, ambient lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table, with a glass and bottle softly blurred in the background.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle light reflections.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with golden-brown, slightly crispy edges and tender, pale interior.
The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, with visible noodles and toppings, showing gentle surface ripples.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl on pale yellow, scalloped edge, slightly textured surface.
